thread:
Nora (Content): Quick note 15m interview with Lighthouse Bio this morning. Raw + timestamps in Drive. Need a short hero quote, legal OK, and CRM routing before we publish.

Eli (PMM): Nice. Paste the one-liner you want for the hero and target publish date.

Nora (Content): Candidate quote: "Redwood helped us scale inference so teams could ship features faster." Target publish: 2026-10-12.

Sam (AE): Lighthouse asks that inbound demo leads from the case page route to their Customer Success Ops first, then fall back to our enterprise team after 48h. Also include campaign=lighthouse_vignette_q4 and token=lighthouse_tok_1026.

crm-bot: Provide routing as comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Sam (AE): Routing payload: lead_source=lighthouse_vignette,owner=lighthouse-cs-ops,fallback_owner=redwood-enterprise,followup_delay=48h,campaign=lighthouse_vignette_q4,token=lighthouse_tok_1026

Priya (Legal): Read the transcript. Two asks: 1) remove a specific percentage the customer mentioned and replace with "significant cost savings"; 2) redact a brief vendor mention. Send the edited hero line and I'll review.

Nora (Content): Edited hero: "Redwood delivered significant cost savings and helped our teams ship features faster." Removed vendor mention.

Eli (PMM): I like that. For the landing deck I'll propose: "How Lighthouse Bio reduced unit costs and accelerated product cycles with Redwood."

Priya (Legal): Approved the edited hero and deck phrasing. Priya (Legal) :white_check_mark:

Hannah (Producer): Great 1 I'll add the approved quote to the landing, make a 60s hero cut, and hand assets to design. Sam, can you confirm the HubSpot payload so I can wire the CTA?

Sam (AE): Confirmed payload above. Also request HubSpot ticket_subject: "Lighthouse vignette - inbound demo".

crm-bot: Routing rule queued to staging with ticket_subject=Lighthouse vignette - inbound demo. Reminder: deploy to prod 60 minutes before publish.

Nora (Content): Thanks team. Next steps: final landing copy in the doc, assets to design, webinar tentatively 2026-10-26 (two weeks after publish). I'll tag legal if anything changes. :rocket:
